source_claim: Nintendo's official Splatoon Base page names Yoko and states that Oonie and Kitamura from Ink Theory are her bandmates; Nintendo's official Splatoon 3 retrospective identifies the Captain as formerly Agent 3.
notes: Nintendo's official Splatoon 3 retrospective says the New Squidbeak Captain is formerly Agent 3 (https://splatoon.nintendo.com/en/news/a-look-back-at-the-three-biggest-groups/), directly supporting the campaign's Captain 3 identity. Nintendo's official Splatoon Base profile names Yoko and states that Oonie and Kitamura from Ink Theory are bandmates in Yoko & the Gold Bazookas (https://www.nintendo.com/jp/character/splatoon/en/music/21/index.html). Only these exact campaign members explicitly identified by Nintendo are proposed; the other campaign members are not inferred from fan wikis, generic species names, or unattributed artwork.
